title: Forgot password link is visible on sign-in page
objective: Verify the password reset entry point is available to signed-out users.

steps.expected_result: The "Forgot password?" link is displayed below the password field.

title: Registered email receives a reset link valid for 30 minutes
objective: Verify a registered customer receives a working, time-limited reset link.

steps.expected_result: The reset request form is displayed.
A confirmation message is shown and one reset email is delivered.

steps.action: Open the reset link from the email within 30 minutes.

title: Reset link is rejected after 30 minutes
preconditions: A reset link was requested 31 minutes ago.

steps.expected_result: An "expired link" message is shown and no password form is displayed.

title: Unregistered email shows the same confirmation message
objective: Verify the response does not reveal whether an account exists.

steps.action: Submit an unregistered email on the reset form.
steps.expected_result: The confirmation text is identical to the registered-email case and no email is sent.

title: New password length boundaries 11/12/64/65
objective: Verify the 12-64 character password policy at its boundaries.
preconditions: A valid reset link is open.

steps.expected_result: Validation error: password must be 12-64 characters.
Password is accepted and the success page is shown.

steps.action: Request a new link, enter a 65-character password and submit.
steps.data: =SUM(A1) followed by 57 more characters to reach 65 total length
steps.expected_result: Validation error: password must be 12-64 characters.
